subject: Runway supplement request for POC scaling — nightly soak window
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie@cardinaltech.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short runway supplement for overnight soak (POC)

Hey Olga,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team at Cardinal is excited to move to an overnight soak to validate 99th percentile latency at scale. We want to run a 6-hour soak starting at 22:00 PST on Wednesday (Oct 7) and need additional trial credits to cover the burst for that window.

Quick details: target sustained ingest ~450–550 rps, peak spikes to ~800rps for 15s, KV-cache warmed, long-tail sequences up to 1,200 tokens for a subset. We expect about ~1.1M tokens across the window.

Can Redwood provision a temporary credit top-up (or sandbox buffer) for that night? If helpful, procurement can sign a short commitment or a credit-usage acknowledgement. I attached our proposed soak spec and load schedule.

Appreciate a quick run-rate estimate and whether you can approve a temporary uplift.

—Jamie
Jamie Liu
Staff Engineer, Cardinal Tech
jamie@cardinaltech.com

Attachment: soak_spec.pdf (application/pdf), load_schedule.csv (text/csv)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie@cardinaltech.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short runway supplement for overnight soak (POC)

Jamie — great to hear the team is ready to soak. Thanks for the clear numbers and the attachments.

High level: we can provision a provisional sandbox buffer to cover the Oct 7 window. Based on your token estimate and peak concurrency, I can offer an interim uplift of 12,000 credits to cover the soak (this is a provisional one-time grant while we confirm any commercial terms).

Two quick asks before I lock it in:
- Confirm the exact 22:00–04:00 PST window you want us to provision.
- Do you need any Dedicated routing (regional GPU pinning) or is Hosted API fine?

If procurement prefers a simple usage acknowledgment, we can send a short DocuSign that documents the temporary uplift and expected usage. Otherwise, if you want a longer trial extension or committed discount for future runs, I'll loop in Sean.

I attached a brief soak checklist we use internally. If you confirm the window and routing, I'll schedule the uplift and send the DocuSign link.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai

Attachment: approval_note.txt (text/plain)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Cardinal Tech soak — provisional uplift ask

[Forwarding thread from Jamie at Cardinal] — short ask: 12k credits provisional for a 6h overnight soak (22:00–04:00 PST, Oct 7).

Notes / internal:
- Customer will accept a DocuSign usage acknowledgment instead of a formal contract for this one-off run.
- Workload: sustained 450–550 rps with brief spikes to 800rps; 1.1M tokens estimated.
- Risk: potential overrun if they spike beyond the plan — recommend we set an automated breaker at 125% of expected token use and notify both sides.

Sean — can we approve the 12k as a marketing/promotion credit and route it from our trial pool? Karthik — can you sign off on the breaker + monitoring plan and coordinate with infra to reserve capacity that night?

Thanks,
Olga

- What we provisioned: 12,000 provisional credits visible in your sandbox account; expires 2026-10-08 04:00 PST + 24-hour cleanup.
- Breaker policy: automated throttle at 125% of your estimated token consumption; alerting will notify both sides and pause ingestion if triggered.

- DocuSign: please review and sign the short usage acknowledgment here: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-cardinal-tech (DocuSign records the window and acceptance of the provisional uplift).
